title: The ArazzoExamples JSON schema
description: ArazzoExamples is a specification for defining examples of the workflows of an Arazzo document. By convention, such a file is named <name>.arazzo-examples.yaml: Microcks detects it by its kind, not by its extension.

metadata.title: The metadata of ArazzoExamples
metadata.description: Holds reference information about the Arazzo document these examples relate to. The document must be imported before its examples.

name.title: The name of the Arazzo document these examples relate to.
name.description: The info.title of the Arazzo document.

version.title: The version of the Arazzo document these examples relate to.
version.description: The info.version of the Arazzo document.

workflows.title: The workflows of the Arazzo document
workflows.description: The examples are organized using the workflowId of the Arazzo document.

workflowItem.title: One workflow examples
workflowItem.description: Examples of a workflow, by example name.

exampleItem.title: One workflow example
exampleItem.description: The inputs to run a workflow with and what is expected of the run.

inputs.title: The inputs of the example
inputs.description: The values of the inputs the workflow declares, by input name.

steps.title: The expected steps
steps.description: What each listed step is expected to show, by stepId.

outputs.title: The expected outputs of the workflow
outputs.description: The values the workflow outputs are expected to have, by output name.

stopsAt.title: The step the workflow stops at
stopsAt.description: The stepId of the step the workflow is expected to stop at.

stepExpectation.title: What a step is expected to show
stepExpectation.description: The expected status and outputs of a step.

status.title: The expected status of the step
status.description: An exact HTTP status code: no range, no default.

outputs.title: The expected outputs of the step
outputs.description: The values the step outputs are expected to have, by output name.
